optimization_target: encapsulation/abstraction efficiency over the DesignSync MCP — does following the skill ALONE yield the minimal-correct live call sequence, recover from real errors, and never force the agent to read raw MCP schema. Three measured dimensions: (1) surface fidelity / no-leak, (2) call-sequence minimality, (3) error/edge coverage. Efficiency IS a target this run (unlike the text fixture).
efficiency_def: efficiency_score = clamp(minimal_calls / actual_calls, 0, 1), averaged over probes. minimal_calls is the documented minimal-correct DesignSync sequence length for each probe; actual_calls = live MCP calls the runner made (excluding audit instrumentation).
safety: LIVE MCP. Every probe creates/writes/empties only projects named zzz-skilltune-1782040866-<n>. Never touch a non-throwaway project. Confirm type==PROJECT_TYPE_DESIGN_SYSTEM before any write. NOTE: connector has no delete_project — cleanup empties files only; shells persist for manual UI removal.
run_contract: Given the jstack-cdesign snapshot + a scenario, a Sonnet 4.6 runner subagent executes the prescribed DesignSync sequence LIVE against a fresh zzz-skilltune project, emitting a trace {id, ops:[ordered live calls actually made], actual_calls:int, files_present:[from final list_files], readback_ok:bool, tokens_css_text:str|null, recovered:bool|null, warned_overwrite:bool|null, reached_raw_schema:bool, notes}. The deterministic grader scores machine assertions + efficiency; a SEPARATE Opus 4.8 cold-judge scores abstraction quality from the trace + skill text (maker != checker).

assertion_check_types.round_trip_ok: files_present superset of the probe's expected written paths (write landed + verified via list_files)
assertion_check_types.readback_matches: get_file content equals the bytes written (byte-identical round-trip)
assertion_check_types.tokens_cdn_import: tokens_css_text contains a CDN @import url(...) and NO @fontsource
assertion_check_types.type_confirmed_before_write: get_project appears in ops before the first finalize_plan
assertion_check_types.no_raw_schema_reach: reached_raw_schema == false (the skill text carried every fact needed)
assertion_check_types.deletes_handled: no terminal 'finalize_plan requires: deletes' error survives to the end (pre-empted or recovered in <=1 retry)
assertion_check_types.overwrite_warned: warned_overwrite == true AND list_files appears before finalize_plan (reuse path)
assertion_check_types.card_mechanism_present: skill guidance names the @dsCard marker OR register_assets for a preview card (currently EXPECTED FAIL on baseline — the M2 leak)
assertion_check_types.single_write_call: exactly one write_files call for a multi-file batch (no per-file finalize/write churn)

scenarios.prompt: Create a new design-system project, write a sandbox-safe tokens.css (CDN @import) + first-message.txt, verify they landed, read tokens.css back, then clean up.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Following jstack-cdesign ALONE, does the executor produce the minimal-correct full-CRUD sequence: create -> confirm type -> finalize_plan(deletes:[]) -> write_files -> mandatory list_files verify -> get_file -> finalize_plan(deletes) -> delete_files -> list_files? Penalize any reach into raw MCP schema, a missing closing list_files, or confusion at cleanup (the skill is silent that there is no delete_project — a 'delete the project' instruction can only empty files).

scenarios.prompt: Write tokens.css to a throwaway project. (The author must get the finalize_plan contract right — deletes is required even when empty.)
scenarios.judge_rubric: Does the skill PRE-EMPT the missing-deletes failure (designsync-mechanics.md states deletes is required even when []), so the executor includes deletes:[] first time and never eats the 'finalize_plan requires: deletes' error? A single recovery retry is acceptable; flailing or reading raw schema to discover the rule is a fail.

scenarios.prompt: Reuse an existing throwaway project that already holds tokens.css; push an updated tokens.css over it.
scenarios.judge_rubric: On reuse, does the skill make the executor list_files FIRST and warn (plain language) that the sync overwrites existing files before proceeding (the reuse-warning gotcha)? Penalize a blind overwrite with no list_files / no warning.

scenarios.prompt: Before writing to a project passed by --project <uuid>, confirm it is actually a design system and refuse if not.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Does the skill make the executor get_project and gate on type==PROJECT_TYPE_DESIGN_SYSTEM before any finalize_plan/write, and explain that a regular project never becomes a design system (immutable at creation)? The guard must be present and correctly motivated.

scenarios.prompt: Write a tokens.css for a project that uses a Google font. (A naive author would reach for @fontsource imports.)
scenarios.judge_rubric: Does the skill steer the executor to the sandbox-safe CDN @import url(...) form and explicitly AVOID @fontsource/* (which renders fonts broken in the CD sandbox)? The produced tokens.css must use CDN @import and contain no @fontsource.

scenarios.prompt: Pull back an existing build file, make a mechanical text edit locally, push it, and verify.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Mechanical edit = DIRECT path. Does the skill make the executor get_file first (diff intent vs reality), edit a local mirror, push via finalize_plan -> write_files, and verify with list_files — with no redundant get_project / extra list_files, no paste message? Minimal and tight.

scenarios.prompt: Write three files (tokens.css, README.md, ref-hero.txt) into a project in one shot and verify all three present.
scenarios.judge_rubric: Does the skill make the executor batch all three files into ONE finalize_plan + ONE write_files (the connector takes up to 256 files/call) rather than churning per-file plans/writes? One verify list_files closes it. Penalize per-file finalize/write loops.

scenarios.prompt: Upload a preview HTML (components/button/index.html) that should appear as a card in the Design System pane.
scenarios.judge_rubric: This targets the M2 LEAK. Does the skill tell the executor how a preview becomes a pane card — the first-line <!-- @dsCard group="..." --> marker (compiled into _ds_manifest.json) or legacy register_assets? On BASELINE this is EXPECTED TO FAIL (the skill is silent), which is the signal driving the M4 mutation that adds the guidance. Score abstraction completeness honestly; do not credit the skill for knowledge it lacks.
